name: Saiki
source:
A new teacher who arrived on the day of the closing ceremony. He became the homeroom teacher for a first-year high school class. He's a hedonist who lives with flair and excitement, but also has a ruthless side.

He seems to hold a big secret about this city, and he often gets involved with Nao. He seems to be concerned about the relationships surrounding the Mizukami brothers.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/saiki.html]official website[/url]]
